episodes.name: Nature of the Beast
episodes.overview: Gibbs and the NCIS team have to find answers regarding Tony's months-long assignment when an NCIS agent is found dead.

episodes.name: Restless
episodes.overview: The NCIS team uncovers a startling surprise after a young Marine shows up to his homecoming party with a fatal stab wound.

episodes.name: The Penelope Papers
episodes.overview: The line between McGee's personal and professional life is blurred when NCIS uncovers a connection between his grandmother and the murder of a Navy Lieutenant.

episodes.name: Enemy on the Hill
episodes.overview: The NCIS team searches for the person and motive behind a contract killer targeting a Navy Lieutenant Commander.

episodes.name: Safe Harbor
episodes.overview: When a coast guard officer is gunned down on a cargo vessel, the NCIS team searches for the killer, but finds a Lebanese family seeking refuge on American soil.

episodes.name: Thirst
episodes.overview: An NCIS case changes from accidental death to murder when evidence reveals that a Navy Lieutenant died of forced over-hydration.

episodes.name: Devil's Triangle
episodes.overview: The NCIS team searches for answers when the current husband of both Gibbs' and Fornell's ex-wife is suspiciously kidnapped.

episodes.name: Engaged (1)
episodes.overview: The NCIS team uncovers a discrepancy with DNA remains when investigating the crash of a military plane that had been transporting caskets.

episodes.name: Engaged (2)
episodes.overview: As the NCIS team continues its search for a missing Marine, Gibbs and Ziva travel to her last known whereabouts in Afghanistan.

episodes.name: Sins of the Father
episodes.overview: After Anthony DiNozzo, Sr. is found in a car with a dead body in the trunk and no memory of the previous night, the NCIS team must figure out if he is capable of murder.

episodes.name: Newborn King
episodes.overview: When a Navy Captain is killed in a hotel room, NCIS must track down and protect his very pregnant companion from unknown assailants.

episodes.name: Housekeeping
episodes.overview: An investigation into the murder of a Navy Commander leads the NCIS team to E.J. Barrett’s whereabouts.

episodes.name: A Desperate Man
episodes.overview: When a Navy Lieutenant Commander is found dead in a building under construction, NCIS must search for a killer while dealing with interruptions from her distraught detective husband.

episodes.name: Life Before His Eyes
episodes.overview: During a routine stop for his morning coffee, Gibbs finds himself staring down the barrel of a gun, forcing him to question choices he has made in the past and present.

episodes.name: Secrets
episodes.overview: When a Navy Captain is found dead with an unusual costume hidden under his uniform, NCIS uncovers a secret society of real-life super heroes and must track down the villain.

episodes.name: Psych Out
episodes.overview: Gibbs clashes with Dr. Samantha Ryan over the truth behind a Navy reservist's possible suicide.

episodes.name: Need to Know
episodes.overview: Top-secret clearance from a Naval research laboratory is jeopardized when the murder of a Chief Petty Officer is connected to an international arms dealer.

episodes.name: The Tell
episodes.overview: The Secretary of the Navy partners Gibbs with Dr. Samantha Ryan after top secret information is leaked by someone on the inside.

episodes.name: The Good Son
episodes.overview: A case hits close to home when the lead suspect in the murder of a Petty Officer is Director Vance's brother-in-law.

episodes.name: The Missionary Position
episodes.overview: Following the murder of a Marine, Tony and Ziva join Ziva’s longtime friend and mentor in Columbia in a search for a missing Marine Lieutenant and Navy Chaplain.

episodes.name: Rekindled
episodes.overview: After a warehouse fire reveals missing Navy documents, posing a potential threat to national security, the NCIS team joins the Baltimore P.D. investigation, reuniting Tony with a boy from his past.

episodes.name: Playing with Fire
episodes.overview: The NCIS investigation of a fire on a Navy vessel reveals evidence that elevates security at all U.S. Navy facilities worldwide.

episodes.name: Up in Smoke
episodes.overview: The NCIS team analyzes what secrets could be in the hands of a terrorist targeting the Navy when a high-tech bug is found inside a probationary agent’s tooth.

episodes.name: Till Death Do Us Part
episodes.overview: Terrorism shakes the foundations of the Navy and NCIS to such an extent that Gibbs and the team face surprises that will devastate them.
